description: TransCAD is Caliper Corporation's GIS-based package for modelling passenger and freight transportation. It implements all steps of travel demand models, from trip generation, trip distribution and mode choice to fast, highly convergent multimodal, multi-class traffic assignment, as well as schedule-based transit networks and transit assignment with GTFS support, activity-based models, road and transit origin-destination matrix estimation, non-motorised travel analysis and freight applications, plus logistics, routing and scheduling, network analysis and facility location. Caliper states that it is used in more than 90 countries, for the travel demand models of more than 70 percent of US metropolitan planning agencies that model, by more than 40 state DOTs, and for national freight models by the Federal Highway Administration and the Federal Railroad Administration. Access: commercial Windows software bought from Caliper; it is programmable in the Caliper GISDK scripting language with more than 500 macro functions, in Python and in COM and .NET languages. Caveats: licences are paid, prices are not published on the overview page, and it runs only on Windows. It supports network flow and capacity planning, freight and passenger scenario analysis and disruption studies on regional networks, and pairs with TransModeler, also catalogued here, for traffic simulation.
